name: Morgan vs. Luffy! Who's This Beautiful Young Girl?
description: Luffy and Zoro battle axe-armed Captain Morgan and cowardly son Helmeppo to save Coby and a captive girl, toppling the tyrant and earning a Marine bounty on Luffy's head.
commentary: The first episode to use “I’m Becoming King of the Pirates,” one of my favorite tracks of the One Piece OST. I’m sentimental, so of course the episode where we watch Luffy recruit his first ever crewmate to truly begin his grand adventure made its way into my favorite episodes of the series. This episode was the one that truly hooked me!

name: Luffy Tatsu! Uragirareta Yakusoku no Ketsumatsu!
description: Moved by Nami's sacrifice, the Straw Hats storm Arlong Park. With Zoro wounded and Usopp cornered, Sanji's fiery kick clears a path while Luffy smashes the gates, declaring he'll end Nami's nightmare himself.
commentary: The first time (of many more to come) that One Piece brought me to tears. The friendship between Nami and the crew is so special, and I think this episode truly showed Luffy’s character and heart. There is nothing more iconic in the early episodes than Nami’ “Luffy help me” and the walk to Arlong Park!

name: Densetsu wa Hajimatta! Mezase Grand Line
description: Miraculously saved from death by an unnatural green gust and a lightning bolt to Buggy, the Straw Hats rush out of Loguetown.
commentary: I love this episode as one of the first episodes that the world begins to recognize Luffy’s similarities to Gold Roger. Along with Luffy, I, too, was interested in the backstory of Gold Roger, which was an aspect of Loguetown that I loved in general. There was still so much mystery in the story at this point!

name: Oujo Vivi o Todokero! Luffy Kaizoku Dan Shukkou
description: Luffy agrees to take Vivi with them.
commentary: This episode may not have the highest rating, but I appreciate the emotional whiplash. We begin with the hilarity of Luffy and Zoro’s misunderstanding and Vivi accidentally revealing the identity of Mr. 0, to Igaram’s tragic sacrifice and the mysterious appearance of Miss All Sunday. I just like this one.

name: Hiluluk no Sakura to Uketsugareyuku Ishi!
description: Flashbacks revealing the death of Dr. Hiruluk and the cruelty of Wapol as the king at that time and how Chopper is encouraged to carry on Dr. Hiruluk's will.
commentary: Ok this is really the episode that first made me sob watching One Piece. It just kept getting worse and worse. But Hiruluk calling Chopper his son was what really got me.

name: Nami no Senpuu Chuuihou! Clima Takt Sakuretsu
description: It's a fight between Miss Doublefinger and Nami with her new weapon, Clima Tact.
commentary: This may not even be close to the best fight in One Piece, but Nami being one of my favorite characters, I love seeing a display of her grit, intelligence, and her dedication towards not becoming a burden to the crew. She really did that!

name: Hajimari wa Ano Hi! Vivi ga Kataru Boukentan!
description: Vivi gives her speech in front of the people of Alabasta today. At the same time, Straw Hat crew waits for her to come and sail with them. However, the Marine begins to chase them. It turns out that Vivi has Igaram to stand in the podium, while she and Karoo go to the promised location. In front of the crew, and heard by all of Alabasta's people, Vivi states that she loves her country and therefore she can't join Luffy. However, she hopes that they will still think of her as a friend. To prevent the Marines knowing her relationship with them, the Straw Hat crew answers her by showing their mark of friendship on their arms.
commentary: Sob sob. Vivi is a Straw Hat in my heart. I loved that they used We Are in this episode, too. Definitely a tearjerker.

name: Yume o Miruna! Azakeri no Machi Mock Town!
description: Luffy and Zoro are beaten by Bellamy so they and Nami go back to the ship. Robin finds information about the Sky Island and the crew departs, but they are confronted with pirate Shojo.
commentary: This episode sets up SO much, it is a crazy episode to rewatch once you’re caught up. Blackbeard is set up as Luffy’s ultimate foil and gives one of the greatest lines (in my opinion of course). I love Jaya in general because it feels the most to me like a grand adventure romantic-era style.

name: Ichioku no Otoko! Sekai Saikou Kenryoku to Kaizoku Kurohige
description: Luffy defeats Bellamy and recovers Cricket's gold.
commentary: The most satisfying punch (so far!). I love this moment as one of those moments where people underestimate Luffy, but he proves them completely wrong.

name: Fune wa Sora o Yuku! Knock-Up Stream ni Nore
description: The Going Merry is repaired and the crew sails to meet the Knock Up Stream and find the Sky Island. Blackbeard goes after Luffy.
commentary: Again, I love how grand an adventure it feels to try to get to Sky Island! The moment that Nami figures out how to get the Merry to fly (set to We Are) is such a gratifying moment. The Straw Hat crew proved they can do anything they set their minds to!

name: Eien no Shinyuu! Oo-unabari ni Hibikuchikai no Kane!!
description: The cause of the hatred is discovered and explained. Meanwhile, Calgara vows to meet Noland again.
commentary: What a backstory. I cried.

name: Semaru Kaigun no Sousa mou! Torawareta Futari Me!
description: Luffy and Sanji are discovered in the kitchen but they manage to escape. Usopp is caught by Drake and taken with Zoro. Robin kidnaps the General Inspector.
commentary: I love G8, but Robin impersonating the inspector is really one of my favorite bits of the whole arc. Ironically, she looks great in Marine attire. But then, she could pull off anything.

name: Luffy vs Usopp! Butsukaru Otoko no Iji
description: A dispute over the Going Merry leads Usopp to challenge Luffy to a duel, putting the Straw Hats' friendship to the test in Water 7.
commentary: I both love and hate this episode for Usopp. It’s always crazy to watch a comic relief character suddenly experience a very dramatic moment, and Usopp giving his all to defeat Luffy in their duel tugs at my heartstrings. Chopper running to give him medicine against Zoro’s warnings gets me too!

name: Ikitai to Ie! Oretachi wa Nakama da!!
description: At Enies Lobby, Robin’s tragic past comes to light as the Straw Hats confront the World Government. With time running out, Luffy urges her to speak her true wish, turning the rescue into a high-stakes showdown.
commentary: This episode has one of the greatest moments in the entire story in my opinion. I always feel so teary eyed watching.

name: Arigatou Merry! Yuki ni Kemuru Wakare no Umi
description: After their escape from Enies Lobby, the Straw Hats meet Iceburg and the Galley-La Company at sea. On the way back to Water 7, they confront the Going Merry’s worsening condition and what it means for their journey.
commentary: I never thought I would be sobbing over a boat but here we are.

name: Perona Kyoufu!? Uso no U wa Usopp no U
description: Usopp defeats Perona using his negativeness and his lies. Sanji and Luffy's zombies finally surrender to Moria. The battle between Zoro and Brook's zombie seems to be through.
commentary: This isn’t the greatest moment of Thriller Bark, but the concept of the battle between Usopp and Perona is so utterly hilarious (while also being sort of sad). Perona truly met her match in Usopp. Horohorohoro.

name: Oars Plus Moria: Chikara to Zunou no Saikyou Gattai
description: The fight against Oars continues while Luffy returns to the mansion yard. Kuma tells Moria about the new Shichibukai Blackbeard. Moria joins Oz, and he demonstrates his intelligence. Brook appears carrying salt.
commentary: I find Kuma’s “introduction” to be terrifying. When I first watched him disappear Perona, I felt pure dread. So obviously, as a horror fan, this one is a favorite of mine.

name: Nakama no Itami wa Waga Itami: Zoro Kesshi no Tatakai
description: On Thriller Bark, the exhausted Straw Hats face Bartholomew Kuma's terrifying power, and Zoro is pushed to the limits of loyalty and resolve.
commentary: Once again, Kuma is such a terrifying antagonist in this arc to me. The creepy siren noise that plays when he pulls out Luffy’s pain is bone-chilling. Zoro is one of my favorite characters, and I think taking Luffy’s pain was the moment that revealed just how drastically his relationship to being a member of the Straw Hats had changed since that first encounter in Shells Town. How can he be the world’s greatest swordsman if he can’t protect his crew?

name: Binks no Sake: Kako to Genzai o Tsunagu Uta
description: Brook continues to tell the tale of the Rumbar Pirates' fateful journey into the Grand Line, and the decision he made at the end of his original life.
commentary: I had initially skipped this episode, thinking that I just wanted to move on to the next arc without having to get through another backstory. But then I circled back because I felt bad and PHEW. Oh Brook, you poor soul.

name: Hyouteki wa Camie!! Semaru Hitosaraiya no Mashu
description: Departing from Shakky’s Rip-off Bar, Luffy’s group attempt to search for Rayleigh but get distracted by Sabaody Park. Zoro is disrespectful to Saint Charlos, causing him to be shot at.
commentary: This arc is the first time that One Piece shows its true hidden darkness in a way that it hasn’t before (although we caught a glimpse in Water 7 and Enies Lobby!) I get emotional when Camie tells them about how going to Sabaody Park had been a dream of hers since she was a little girl. The soundtrack that plays during that scene is beautiful.

name: Tekken Sakuretsu! Auction wo Buttsubuse
description: At a Sabaody action, the Straw Hats try to free Camie, but a Celestial Dragon’s bid derails their plan. When Luffy crashes the venue, a tense standoff threatens to spiral out of control.
commentary: The darkness of One Piece is fully out in the open at this point. I had not gone into One Piece thinking it would end up having such disturbing concepts. Now THIS was the most satisfying punch in all of One Piece, and the first time the animation wowed me.

name: Houimou o Toppa Seyo! Kaigun Tai Sannin no Senchou
description: Luffy, Law, and Kid’s crews join the fight and defeat the rest of the Marines outside the Auction House. The three captains promise to meet and fight in the New World.
commentary: I just really like Law. If I could choose any devil fruit power to have for myself, it would be his.

name: Kiesarata Nakama-tachi: Mugiwara Ichimi Saigo no Hi
description: At Sabaody Archipelago, the Straw Hats are cornered by Marines and Pacifistas, and Luffy fights to protect his crew when Bartholomew Kuma’s mysterious paw power threatens to separate them.
commentary: More Kuma! This episode is so sad and frustrating, and it’s the first time we’ve seen Luffy so helpless. I was so stressed out!

name: Okose Saigo no Kiseki: Seigi no Mon wo Toppaseyo
description: Magellan orders one of the warships to come to him in order to go after the escaped convicts. The Gate of Justice looms before Luffy and the others.
commentary: I really liked Magellan as a villain, because outside of his IBS, I thought he was one of the scariest villains Luffy has faced. Dude was literally melting people. Luffy couldn’t even defeat him, he merely escaped, and it was only barely! Talk about stress.

name: Hi wo Yakitsukusu Chikara: Akainu Hijou no Tsuigeki
description: Whitebeard orders the pirates to flee Marineford, but Akainu’s merciless pursuit and provocation put Ace and Luffy’s escape in grave danger.
commentary: My grandfather who is caught up to One Piece once texted me: 'Ace is saved!' and I asked him what episode he was on and he said '482' and I didn't really know what to say back so I just sent a party favor emoji.

name: Aitsura ni Aitee! Luffy Namida no Sakebi
description: Garp faces Dadan’s anger upon returning to Foosha Village, while a grief-stricken Luffy struggles to find a way forward as Jinbe tries to pull him out of despair.
commentary: This episode really breaks my heart...

name: Eiyuu no Saigo: Tiger Shougeki no Shinjitsu
description: The Sun Pirates start making their way to Koala’s hometown while giving her a slight makeover, new clothes, and cutting her hair. On their ship, Koala still acts like a slave would, doing chores without being asked and asking for orders.
commentary: I know it's a joke among the One Piece community that Fishman Island is difficult to get through, but I didn't find it all bad. I really liked the backstory of Fisher Tiger and his crew taking care of Koala, and the ending really broke my heart. Why is it most of my favorite episodes are ones that made me sad?

name: Shichibukai! Trafalgar Law
description: Chopper and Nami, leading the children, stumble upon a room with people frozen. Franky, Sanji, and the samurai start to make their way towards Nami and Chopper. Luffy, Zoro, Usopp, and Robin get attacked by the centaurs.
commentary: I waited so long for this episode. Live laugh Law.

name: Luffy Kyougaku: Ace no Ishi o Tsugu Otoko
description: Bartolomeo saves Bellamy from Dellinger who is called to guard the Toy House. Thunder Soldiers explains “Operation SOP.” As Luffy looks for the Colosseum’s exit, he is approached by Sabo.
commentary: I really just have this one here because the reunion between Luffy and Sabo makes all the pain from Marineford worth it! I waited a very long time to reach this episode too :').

name: Yuke Law: Yasashiki Otoko Saigo no Tatakai!
description: After recalling how he killed his father and met his executives as a child, Donquixote Doflamingo confronts his brother, Rosinante.
commentary: Once again, the sad ones really get me. But this one is really more bittersweet and Corazon is a wonderful, wonderful character.

name: A Liar! Luffy and Sanji!
description: After a harsh struggle, Luffy finally manages to defeat Counter. Sanji arrives and finds Luffy. Luffy decides to help Sanji when he hears his reasons for attending the party.

name: Time for Farewell! Pudding’s One Last Request!
description: Carrot tells Sanji the news about Pedro. Germa and the Sun  pirates continue on fighting with the Big Mom Pirates to allow for the straw hats to escape. Pudding remembers her time with Sanji. Brulee tends to Katakuri.

name: The Sea Is For Pirates! Raid! To Onigashima
description: With no allies coming to their aid, the Nine Red Scabbards row to Onigashima on their own.

name: Kaido’s Trump Card - Introducing the Tobi Roppo
description: The Straw Hat Pirates enter Onigashima’s torii gate. Queen begins the Golden Kagura festivities, and the Tobi Roppo meet to hear their captain’s request.

name: Straw Hat Luffy! The Man Who Will Become the King of the Pirates!
description: Yamato reveals his dream to Ace in a flashback. Meanwhile Luffy, Zoro, Law, Kidd, and Killer confront Kaido and Big Mom on the rooftop.

name: Clutch! A Demon Incarnate, Robin!
description: Black Maria torments Robin both physically and spiritually. As she burns in hellfire, Robin remembers the people who gave her a hard time and the people who supported her. As a Demon Child, she shows what she is really capable of.

name: Luffy is Defeated?! The Determination of Those Left Behind
description: The battle between Luffy and Kaido comes to an unexpected end. Kaido comes down and tells everyone that Luffy has been defeated and the Land of Wano is finished. Momonosuke and Yamato argue over whether they should still continue fighting.

name: Fan Letter
description: Inspired by Nami, a young girl embarks on an adventure.

name: Kuma’s Life
description: Bonney sails out to sea in search of her father and rises to prominence. At the same time, Luffy makes his name by defeating the Arlong Pirates and declaring war against the World Government. Watching his actions, Kuma begins to hold a certain belief.

name: I Want You to Praise Me - The Reunion of Robin and Saul
description: The crew finally arrive at the Western Village in the Sun World, but Robin has something she can’t get off her mind.
